scope: Source raster-window coverage and opaque-clip classification; full filter/original acceptance remains open.

sharedContract.problem: Tight continuous curve extrema can exclude numerical raster ink. Captured source construction used its padded window, but its paint interior clipped that ink to layout bounds. Opaque-clip classification also used a request enclosure that could hide an antialiased fringe.
sharedContract.change: RasterFrame.RasterClip and LayerRasterBounds name the existing admitted window. Geometry construction, clip-resource construction and paint interior use it. PolygonPaintClip uses existing ActiveClipBounds, shared with polygon traversal, to inspect the actual bitmap coverage tape. ContentClip retains source layout/request and sampling roles.
sharedContract.ownership: No new fields, owners, buffers, cache or public API. Additional paint stays within the already admitted source image. The existing curved-source ownership case is strengthened with the overhanging cubic and fractional placement; denial, cancellation, retained-source immutability, cleanup and retry use the existing helper.
sharedContract.unchanged: Blur, color-space, alpha and transform arithmetic; all existing PNG targets and exactness rules; text, logical sizing and uniform fitting.

captureContext.reason: The native tiled canvas changes construction and filter restoration. A smaller matching-aspect crop is a different raster context and cannot replace this reference.
captureContext.executableIdentities: Recorded independently for both platforms in each reference metadata file.

mechanismEvidence.recipe: Use filter-raster-fringe.svg, remove filter and clip-path attributes and set opacity1. Render the source on the capture grid with an outer rectangle equal to its padded construction window. Do not compare a crop of the global canvas as though it were that source grid.
mechanismEvidence.innerClip: With only the paint-window correction, the upper source grid is exact. On the lower grid, request-bound classification incorrectly selects binary coverage:44 source-alpha differences/max7/88 total remain, producing4 final alpha differences/max1. Inspecting actual coverage bounds makes both final inner-clip controls exact.
mechanismEvidence.exploratoryCompanions: Seven own variants (original, unclipped, opacity1, unfiltered, unfiltered-opacity1, unclipped-opacity1 and clip-mask) are exact under the shared prototype. Inner-clip opacity1 is also exact. These exploratory controls reuse their independently captured native images and do not constitute additional admitted references.

rejectedSimplifications.change: Treat the entire padded raster window as ContentClip and remove the separate role.
rejectedSimplifications.reason: Fails seven unchanged native references on each host: cropped/displaced transparent and composed blurs, rescaled blur with/without opacity, and nested-filter halo. Also worsens Gallardo94/123 to95/124 despite making both own controls exact.
Passes existing affected checks but leaves4 final alpha differences in the own inner-clip control; the separate clip-classification cause must also be fixed.

allOriginals.qualification: All204 hashes rechecked per host; all148 rendered PNGs, outcomes and diagnostics remain unchanged under the numerical prototype. Final private names/comments retain that behavior and pass the gates below. Exploratory134 exact/14 different does not close supplied-font/resource/static-state acceptance.

validation.releaseBuilds: Both test projects and TFMs; zero warnings/errors. Fixture assets refreshed after admission.
validation.timing: Busy-host functional elapsed times only; no performance claim.
validation.routineResponsibility: Each fixture uses the existing canonical conversion/manifest check. The inner and outer clip are distinct source/restore interactions, not an API multiplication.

remainingAcceptance: Original Gallardo path3850 remains10 alpha differences/max1, with matching source captures and stored blur values in clipped/unclipped library runs. Its independent mask, unfiltered source, unclipped blur and constant solid/image clip carriers are exact. This source-window fix does not close that original finding.

Gallardo remains94 pixels/123 total channel error; Scimitar221/1,216. Resolve crop, flood/offset, shadows and complete original/font/resource/static-state mappings before closing the whole filter milestone.
